Customers have praised the quality of the food, particularly the deli veggie sandwich and turkey/cheese/avocado sandwich. Many have also noted that the owners are friendly and welcoming. However, some customers have expressed concerns about the decline in the quality of ingredients and preparation, as well as inconsistent customer service. 

In terms of amenities, Plaza Deli offers outdoor seating, takeout options, and is suitable for groups. They do not offer WiFi or parking. 

Overall, Plaza Deli appears to be a popular local deli that offers good food and friendly service. While there have been some recent concerns about the quality of the food and customer service, many customers continue to enjoy their experiences at the deli.
